notes.subject: to profet Ekiesiel
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tokim 'pikinini man' — nem bilong profet man long olgeta buk bilong Ekiesiel.

notes.subject: והטף
notes.rationale: Hibru 'drop daun olsem wara' — min bilong em em i autim tok profet liklik liklik, olsem ren i drop.

notes.subject: bus bilong gaden bilong Negev
notes.rationale: JPS/BHS ritim 'bus bilong saut'; KJV/ol lain ol i tanim olsem 'Yerusalayem, ol ples holi, graun bilong Yisrael' — ol i go long min, no long tok.

translation: Pikinini man, givim pes bilong yu i go long saut, na tok bilong yu i save drop daun olsem wara i go long saut, na autim tok profet i go long bus bilong gaden bilong Negev.

tokens.gloss: tok i save drop daun olsem wara
